original.target_description: Original full primary paper unavailable; shared terminal acquisition record documents failed DOI, Unpaywall, OpenAlex and archive routes. Secondary reproduced estimates in Song are not substituted for the original.

replication.target_description: Difference-GMM private-consumption equation, change in working-age population share; without household disposable income controls; reconstructed 1970–1996 OECD country panel. Uses the direct replication column, not the 1996–2015 extension.

n.sample_role: analytic country-year panel observations in the target regression, across 12 OECD countries
n.exclusions: Reconstructed panel has missing historical data; differencing and lagged values restrict observations. Income-controlled models report 225 rather than 232 observations; no exact exclusion flow is printed.

notes: Original source unavailable: terminal cache miss 21ae3ca30ea09cd7c1aecb17.miss. Original values reproduced by Song were not used. Requested effect type is test statistic, but the target coefficient rows print regression coefficients and Newey–West standard errors, not coefficient-specific t/z tests; retained the printed coefficient without conversion. The table J-test and its p value test instrument restrictions, so neither is substituted for the target coefficient test. Reported success is the author’s overall narrative verdict; no separate verdict for this covariate is printed. No coefficient-specific exact p value or significance star is printed; p left null.
